author: in2forex
text:
Hi All

Last night I studied this chart for a long time. I just couldn't really understand the history and why it turned at that exact point. I'm still not convinced with my reasoning.

Chart 1 My 3D drive (Approach)

Chart 2 (The History) I drew 4 lines on the chart to show the history I was interested in.

Chart 3 (Reaction) I went back to my 3D approach to see how price reacted to these levels. I concluded that on return price Faked Out the FTR 1 to go to a lower SR flip. As price Faked Out the history level it also Faked Out the current low to form the QM level that price eventually took off from.

Chart 4 (putting it all together)

I feel like I'm missing something on the history? Regards In2forex
